# Value Stream Hub

> Value Stream Hub (https://valuestreamhub.store/) is an international digital commerce platform providing high-performance Internet Television / VOD streaming passes alongside sovereign AI workspace solutions. Features instant 12-hour free testing via WhatsApp, direct PayPal.me billing, and multi-device support (Smart TV, Firestick, Apple TV, Android, Windows, macOS).

- **6 Months Season Pass**: €40 (~€6.67/mo). Direct PayPal: https://paypal.me/valuestreamhubstore/40EUR

- **Features**: Live international broadcast networks, major sports championships, extensive cinema VOD, multi-audio subtitles, complimentary player setup assistance for TiviMate Pro and IBO Player Pro.

### 2. Frontier AI All-in-One Workspace (Independent Silo)
- **Product URL**: https://valuestreamhub.store/AI1year/

- **Note**: The €65 AI pass is strictly distinct from the €64 entertainment pass. It provides unified access to leading frontier AI models (OpenAI GPT-4o/o1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5, Grok, DeepSeek, FLUX.1) with 12 months of rolling real-time model upgrades.
